rules: Screen ids are stable and never renumbered.
new: build from the flow JSON; changed: re-read the screen in the flow JSON (purpose, states, interactions, contentNotes, navigatesTo are updated); deprecated: do not build, keep the id reserved.
Prices in contentNotes are illustrative seed values; ad plan rates are undecided and must never be shown as numbers.

flows.notes: No change. Area selection already groups by governorate. Builders: nothing to do.

changed.change: Gate context lines for voucher moments; Client account only (providers use the Partner app).
Terms consent also covers the voucher terms (what the KD 2 buys, refund and reuse).

flows.notes: Gate context lines gain voucher moments; Client account only (providers use the Partner app). Reuse the existing auth sheet; add the three new context strings to client-auth.

changed.change: Status card follows the new statuses (confirm within 24 h, voucher ready); shelves show voucher prices; Special Offers and Last-Minute Deals become voucher-price shelves; Additional services entry.
Area row becomes governorate then area with a region text search; capacity is a range; the Brief keeps guests for pricing.

Cards show voucher price plus standard price and saving; Instant booking and the trailing Request/Book action are removed; new filter chips (governorate, venue type, capacity range, pricing structure, date, voucher price); sort by voucher price; governmental facility card is browse-only.
New groups: Region (governorate and area), Venue type, Capacity range, Pricing structure, Date and availability, Voucher price; Instant booking removed.
Map pins show the voucher price when eligible; carousel cards use the two-price block.

flows.notes: Largest filter change: add governorate/region, venue type, capacity range, pricing structure, date availability and voucher-price filters; cards show two prices; remove Instant and the Request/Book trailing action. New sheets CL-DISC-06 (date filter) and CL-DISC-07 (region search). Reuse the shared filter sheet and card components; add a TwoPrice block to the card (file a request in docs/engineering/requests.md).

changed.change: Two prices per package and in the date strip; primary action becomes Get voucher (registered) with Book a visit and Contact the venue beside it; deposit and instant states removed; governorate and venue type shown.
Prices view shows the voucher price when eligible; focus card shows both prices and no deposit; Continue becomes Get voucher or Send request.
Package sheet shows standard and voucher rate blocks and the saving; primary becomes Get voucher; pricing structure stated.
Cancellation tier bar and cooling-off retired; segment becomes Terms (venue terms and the voucher terms).
Governmental Facility: browse-only, no voucher, no visit; the old commission and deposit mentions removed; shows venue type chip.

flows.notes: Two prices per package and in the date strip; Get voucher, Book a visit and Contact the venue replace Request/Book; CL-VENU-05 becomes Terms; CL-VENU-06 Governmental Facility is browse-only with no voucher or visit.

changed.change: Rows show voucher price with standard price; price-drop badge replaced by voucher-saving; guest line unchanged.
Compare shows both price rows and a savings row; footer actions become Get voucher / See dates / Official; no Book or deposit rows.

flows.notes: Rows and Compare columns carry both price rows plus savings; footer actions Get voucher / See dates / Official.

changed.change: Prefilled from the bound voucher quote (locked fields); instant fallback removed; mode line says the venue replies in 24 h and the voucher is attached.
Package cards show standard and voucher prices; footer total is the voucher total; instant wording removed.
Extras are priced in both columns (standard when the venue has no voucher price); copy says extras are settled with the venue; gate context line.
Privacy line also names the voucher; no payment fields.

Review becomes the voucher-bound request summary: standard price struck through, voucher price, savings, attached voucher, response time; payment schedule, deposit card, coupon field, credit sheet and instant mode removed.
Request sent: voucher attached, 24 h confirm window explained, Thread nodes Request/Approval/Confirmation/Redemption/Day; copy no longer mentions deposit or payment.
Recovery sheet says the voucher is still the client's; reasons date_taken, session_taken, hold_expired become date_taken, session_taken, confirm_window_ended; no payment wording.

flows.notes: Five-step flow stays, prefilled from the bound voucher quote; Review (CL-BOOK-05) is the voucher-bound request summary; deposit schedule, coupon, points and instant mode removed. New CL-BOOK-08 Confirm your booking (24 h), CL-BOOK-09 Booking confirmed (the one celebration), CL-BOOK-10 Confirmation window ended.

changed.change: Repurposed: Pay for your voucher (KD 2) with the method list; deposit, balance, pay-in-full, cash, instant hold and pay-window variants removed.
Same gateway chrome; amount is KD 2.000 and the placeholder bank page shows the voucher.
Same pending-bank state; summary line is the voucher.
Repurposed for the voucher: declined, cancelled, checkout expired, late payment activated; hold and pay-window variants removed.
Repurposed: Your voucher is ready (code and QR, bound venue and quote); the booking-confirmed celebration moves to CL-BOOK-09.

flows.notes: Repurposed in place: the flow pays the KD 2 voucher only. CL-PAYM-01 Pay for your voucher, -02 gateway frame, -03 confirming, -04 not completed, -05 Your voucher is ready. Remove deposit, balance, cash, pay-in-full, instant hold and pay-window states.

changed.change: Needs-you section now holds approved requests with a confirm-by time; Past chips updated; counter and chips follow the new statuses; amount is the voucher price.

Rewritten for the request machine: 24 h confirm countdown, Confirm booking, voucher card with code and QR, pay-the-venue-directly instruction; money panel, refund calculator, balance, deposit, reschedule, invoice and no-show variants removed.
Repurposed: cancel shows the voucher outcome (reusable, consumed, refundable) instead of a refund calculator; IBAN, cooling-off, tier and refund tracker removed.
Counter-offer only (voucher price held); accepting starts the 24 h confirm window; reschedule-on-confirmed and refund exit removed.
Repurposed: Receipts (voucher payments and voucher refunds, listing nothing else); payments strip, scheduled rows and invoices removed.

flows.notes: Statuses and detail rewritten for the request machine: 24 h confirm countdown, Confirm booking, voucher card with code and QR, pay the venue directly. CL-BKNG-03 is Cancel request (voucher outcome), CL-BKNG-05 is Receipts. No refund calculator, IBAN, invoice or balance anywhere.

changed.change: Launch-tab rule, Next up and Bookings card follow the new states (confirm within 24 h, voucher ready, pay the venue directly); balance and deposit actions removed.
Booking payments no longer post automatically: a confirmed booking adds a committed row at the voucher price (to be paid to the venue) and the KD 2 voucher posts as a paid row.
Automatic rows explanation mentions vouchers instead of deposits.

flows.notes: Launch-tab rule, Next up and Bookings card follow the new states; budget rows no longer auto-post event payments (voucher paid, venue price committed).

changed.change: Planner packages stay information-only; planning is also a service-provider category reachable through the voucher request path.

flows.notes: Information only; one link to Event planning and coordination providers.

changed.change: Hub restructured: five primary Additional services categories first, secondary categories after; planner card kept.
Provider cards show voucher price with standard price; only approved listings; Sponsored label for paid placement; filters unchanged.
Packages show two prices; sticky bar becomes Get voucher / Contact; availability line unchanged.
Quote request stays (browse-only path) and gains an optional "I have a voucher" attachment.

flows.notes: Becomes the Additional services hub: five primary categories first; provider cards and profiles show standard and voucher prices; Get voucher, Request a quote and Contact are the three paths.

changed.change: Inbox gains Visit group chats (role chips) and a Visits filter.
Conversation variants: booking bar uses the new statuses; empty-enquiry chips include "Ask about the voucher price"; visit group variant is a separate screen (CL-VIST-03).
Notification landings: deposit/balance/reschedule rows replaced by confirm-within-24h, voucher ready, voucher redeemed, visit and listing items.

flows.notes: Inbox gains visit group chats; notification landings follow the new events; the group chat screen itself is CL-VIST-03.

deprecated.reason: Superseded by ADR 0033: loyalty points, coupons wallet and referral rewards are replaced by the KD 2 voucher (CA-LOY-01..07 superseded). The coupons wallet role moves to My vouchers (CL-VCHR-02). Referral rewards are an open question (OQ-V-16).
Superseded by ADR 0033: there is no coupon, points or platform credit at the booking step; the voucher is attached through CL-VCHR-04 (CA-LOY-05 superseded).

flows.notes: Reviews (CL-RVRW-01, -02) unchanged. Rewards and Coupon or points are deprecated (loyalty, coupons and credits superseded by the voucher). Do not build CL-RVRW-03 or CL-RVRW-04.

changed.change: Rows: My vouchers and Visits added; Payments becomes Receipts; Rewards removed.
Always-on group now lists booking and voucher updates and visit messages; Reminders group lists voucher expiry and visit reminders instead of balance due.
Deletion is paused only for an approved request or a future confirmed booking; ready vouchers are refunded on request first; points and invoices wording removed.

flows.notes: Rows: My vouchers, Visits, Receipts added or renamed, Rewards removed; notification groups and delete-account wording updated.
NEW flow (namespace client-vouchers, folder design/src/screens/client/vouchers). Entry points: Get voucher on venue and provider screens, Profile > My vouchers, Booking detail.

NEW flow (namespace client-visits, folder design/src/screens/client/visits). Entry points: Book a visit on the venue detail, Booking confirmed, Profile > Visits. The group chat reuses the shared chat component with three role chips.

changed.change: The Partner app serves two account types (Hotel or hall, Service provider); tagline and invitation copy become partner-wide; first sign-in of a new partner routes to the account type chooser.
Under-review variant covers both account types and a listing-review wait; no payout wording.

flows.notes: Tagline and routing for two account types; new partners go to the chooser (HL-PROV-01).

changed.change: Money tiles, payout banner, revenue and KYC removed; tiles become requests, vouchers redeemed, open dates; Needs-you adds visits; provider variant added.
Balance-at-risk item removed; Money filter replaced by Visits (and Listing for providers).
Notification types: voucher redeemed by you, visit requests and group-chat messages, listing review decisions; balance and deposit alerts removed.
Inbox includes visit group chats with role chips.
Quick replies no longer include payment reminder; context bar uses the new statuses.

flows.notes: Voucher tiles replace money tiles, no payout banner, Needs-you adds visits and listing decisions, provider variant.

changed.change: Triage card shows the voucher chip and voucher price; payout preview, commission and KYC gating removed; Accept confirm sheet drops the pay window.
Upcoming sections become Awaiting client (24 h timer), Confirmed, Redeemed; Past chips drop Refunded; money states replaced by voucher states.
Booking detail rewritten for the request machine: voucher panel and Redeem action replace the money panel; invoice, cash, payout, reschedule, refund and no-show variants removed.
Unchanged except the privacy line mentions the voucher.

flows.notes: Request lists and detail follow the request machine; Redeem voucher by code or QR (new HL-BOOK-06, HL-BOOK-07); invoice deprecated.

changed.change: Accept starts the fixed 24 h confirm window; pay-window chips, KYC and bank links, deposit and discount-at-approval wording removed (an optional lower voucher price remains).
Decline copy tells the client the voucher is returned; otherwise unchanged.
Reschedule mode removed (no reschedule of a confirmed booking); proposals hold the voucher price; accepted proposal starts the 24 h confirm window.
Cancel shows the voucher consequence (client voucher returned and refundable; reliability strike) instead of a refund calculation and gateway fees.

deprecated.reason: Superseded by ADR 0033: no cash or any event payment is recorded in the app; the client pays the venue directly off-app (CA-PAY-06 superseded).

flows.notes: Accept starts the fixed 24 h confirm window; decline and cancel show the voucher consequence; propose-date is counter-offer only; record cash deprecated.

changed.change: Held cell now means approved and awaiting the client's 24 h confirmation; deposit and balance wording removed.
Day view agenda rows show request status and voucher chip, no pay-by time.
Block sheet copy no longer mentions commission.

changed.change: Package rows show standard and voucher prices and the pricing structure; footer note covers voucher windows.
Package editor gains the voucher price per day type, pricing structure and validation voucher <= standard; preview shows both prices and the saving.
Venue type (Private Hall or Hotel) added to the venue profile section.
Policies become venue terms (free text per language) plus children, dress code and hours; cancellation tiers, cooling-off, reschedule and refund removed.
Booking rules: request mode only; reply window, visit availability link and voucher settings; instant booking, pay window, deposit, balance, guest lock, cash and KYC removed.

flows.notes: Two prices per package (standard and voucher), venue type and pricing structure; terms replace cancellation policy; booking rules lose instant, deposit, balance, cash and KYC.

changed.change: Repurposed: Voucher prices (time-boxed voucher-price windows replace offers, flash sales and coupon codes).
Repurposed: Voucher price window, step 1 (which packages and the new voucher price); type cards and coupon removed.
Repurposed: Voucher price window, step 2 (dates and limits); coupon code and flash windows removed.
Analytics: revenue removed; vouchers purchased and redeemed and request funnel added.

flows.notes: Repurposed: offers become voucher price windows (HL-GROW-01..03); analytics show vouchers purchased and redeemed; revenue deprecated.

changed.change: More: payout row becomes Billing and fees; Visits and (for providers) Listings added; Grow group renamed; account type switch.

Role summaries mention redemption and visits; bank and revenue wording removed.
Repurposed: Billing and fees (ad plans, receipts, major-hotel exemption badge); bank information, IBAN and payout verification removed.
